reasoning: Close-up of wheat stem tissue showing elongated, brick-red to orange-brown uredinia that have ruptured through the epidermis with powdery spore masses visible — classic symptoms of Puccinia graminis f. sp. tritici (wheat stem rust). The elongated pustule shape on stem (not leaf) tissue and the reddish-brown spore color distinguish this from stripe rust (yellow, striped) and leaf rust (smaller, circular, on leaf blade).
